A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''fleet''' [[Skirmish between the Pythea and a Yuuzhan Vong fleet|engaged]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Pythea]]'' in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Azca]], who commanded one of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] ''[[Miid ro'ik]]'' [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], had a [[Yorik-vec assault cruiser|''Yorik-vec'' assault cruiser]] attack the ''Pythea'', which rammed the commander's cruiser.<ref name="Inv02" />
